ns2:course.label: Corporate Finance
ns2:course.description: Analysis of corporate and securities law problems using the tools of modern financial theory. Emphases will typically include valuation, capital structure, and fundamental changes of public corporations. 4 graduate hours. 3 professional hours. Prerequisite: LAW 633.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. 3 professional hours. Prerequisite: LAW 633.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Law department.
